# Route two serves the harbour cafés

## Context Scope

The morning delivery routes.

## Fact Statement

Route two covers the six cafés along the harbour and leaves the bakery first, at 05:30.

## Why This Matters

Anything that delays the first van delays every harbour café's opening stock.
